A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''camp''' was built near the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] organized the attack on [[Camp Six]] and the [[Liberation of Spinnaker|liberation]] of Spinnaker from the camp.<ref name="GB" />
